data.context: In the 2024 IP Australia Economic Research Paper *Raising the Bar reforms: Measuring the impact on relative patent scope*, Appendix B describes machine-learning methods for classifying the relative scope of Australian patent claims. It outlines the algorithms tested on 500 manually assessed patent-family triplets, their use on 2000–2019 triplets, and the report’s choice of a three-way scope target, later grouped as broader versus not broader.
